title: Docker Compose
summary: Describe a whole multi-container application in one compose.yaml: services, builds, env and interpolation, volumes, networks, healthcheck-gated startup, profiles, override files, hot reload with `compose watch`, secrets and configs. You'll build the full shipit stack (API + Postgres + Redis + migration job).
objectives: Write a production-quality compose.yaml for an API with Postgres and Redis
Explain the difference between `environment`, `env_file` and `.env` interpolation, and their precedence
Gate startup order with healthchecks and `depends_on` conditions, including one-off migration jobs
Use profiles and multiple Compose files (override/prod) to serve different environments from one base
Set up `docker compose watch` for hot reload of a Node.js service
Use secrets and configs correctly, and inspect the final model with `docker compose config`
Operate a stack day to day: ps, logs, exec, run, scale, down, down -v
